name: Enbridge Inc. Preferred Shares (ENB.PR.T)
summary: Enbridge Inc. and its subsidiaries form an energy infrastructure company with five core segments. Liquids Pipelines runs pipeline networks and terminals carrying other liquid hydrocarbons as well as crude oil in Canada and the United States. Gas Transmission and Midstream invests in natural gas pipelines and gas gathering and processing, and Gas Distribution and Storage oversees natural gas utilities.
